Orient Bell Limited has informed the Exchange vide its letter dated May 01, 2013 regarding a Press Release dated April 30, 2013 titled "Orient Bell Limited files 4 Product Patents, the maximum in the Tile World".
Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a Press Release dated May 01, 2013, titled "Maruti Suzuki sales in April 2013".
